The contracting author ity has chosen to award the contract resulting from this call for tenders through an open procedure pursuant to Article 167(1)(a) of the Financial Regulation. In this procedure any interested economic operator (any natural or legal person who offers to supply products, provide services or execute works) may submit a tender. 2.2.
